rename.from: Create transparent window ,When there is still a part that is not transparent at startup
rename.to: A window with decorations can't be transparent initially until resized

body:
I poked around and found out: 
- Transparent on electron only works when used in a frameless window, Regular windows cannot be transparent, probably they are using the same api as us.
- We could draw to the window like glutin [transparent](https://github.com/rust-windowing/glutin/blob/cfda993f2700e2cd002160d4f14a3af0ecaae3fb/glutin_examples/examples/transparent.rs) example but with decorations on.

TBH, I am tempted to close this issue and recommend to always use transparent with decorations off but I will keep this open for now.
Just found a workaround, set your decorations to false in tauri.conf, then when your app is loaded use the Javascript API to reset it to true. Worked for me

issue.title: it doesn't work! while I set "background": true on win11

body:
With the newly added [`with_undecorated_shadow`](https://docs.rs/tao/latest/i686-pc-windows-msvc/tao/window/struct.WindowBuilder.html#method.with_undecorated_shadow) for Windows and is planned to be active by default in tauri v2, this bug will also affect undecorated window as well. 

If you still want the shadows with undecorated, the same workaround will work, i.e. start your window undecorated without shadow then enable the shadows back again after the window has been created.
